Apply now or reach out directly to leshagrey@momentum.co.nz for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Finance Business Partner
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Our client is one of New Zealand's largest fully integrated logistics providers, offering seamless global supply chain solutions; from international freight to warehousing and domestic delivery. With a team of over 450 people and an extensive footprint of 13 branches and 6 warehouses nationwide, they are recognised for their leading-edge technology and long-standing partnerships with multinational and local customers.

We are seeking an experienced Finance Business Partner to join their finance team, supporting the Transport business unit with high-quality financial insight and commercial guidance. 

Based in Auckland, this role is pivotal in providing meaningful, purposeful information to business managers on the performance of the Transport business units. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders including the CEO, CFO, GMs and the wider Finance team, to drive profitability and support sound decision-making across the business.

Key Responsibilities
  • Managing Transport business unit P&Ls to ensure targets are met
  • Consolidating, producing and distributing weekly P&Ls and monthly actual/budget/last-year variance reports and commentary
  • Analysing key financial and non-financial business drivers to add value across the Transport business
  • Partnering with business unit managers to develop strategies that maximise profit
  • Preparing budgets and updating budget data into the Finance Management System
  • Courier billing, revenue calculation and cost of sales coding
  • Preparing forecasts, customer sales reports and short-term incentive (STI) schedules
  • Contributing to the ongoing development of customer profitability reporting
  
What We're Looking For  
  • Post-graduate qualification in Business or Accounting, including CPA/CA
  • Experience within Transport and Logistics, 3PL, Supply Chain, Freight Forwarding, or a related industry is preferred but not essential
Skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Systems solutions and process improvement focus
  • Self-directed, with the ability to manage and mentor others
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills
  
Why Apply? This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established, technology-driven logistics business with a strong safety culture and a genuine focus on people, service and performance. You'll work alongside experienced GMs and senior finance leaders in a role with real influence over commercial outcomes.

job.description:
About the Roles:
We currently have two Senior Project Manager opportunities with our clients — one focused on IT/technology delivery, the other on business change and commissioning transformation.

Our client is delivering a programme of information services and technology projects, working closely with a Business Partnering and Delivery Manager and the wider technology leadership team. You'll plan, manage and implement a portfolio of IT projects end-to-end — developing robust project plans, managing budgets, risks and vendor relationships, and ensuring key stakeholders are kept informed on milestones and business benefits. You'll also play a role in lifting project management capability and maturity across the organisation, coaching project teams and providing thought leadership on delivery best practice.

Role 2 – Business Change & Commissioning Transformation
Our client is undertaking a major transformation of how it partners with providers and invests in services, moving from a traditional purchasing model to a more strategic, outcomes-focused commissioning approach. Working alongside a Programme Manager and multiple General and Team Managers, you'll coordinate activity across several interconnected workstreams — including contract changes, provider engagement and assessment, investment frameworks, and phased service recommissioning — while managing risks, dependencies and competing priorities across the programme.
Both roles are highly collaborative, with success driven by influence, facilitation and strong stakeholder relationships rather than formal authority.

Key Responsibilities
  • Developing and maintaining integrated delivery plans across workstreams
  • Managing project scope, budget, schedule, risks and dependencies
  • Supporting contracting, procurement or commissioning activity where relevant
  • Coordinating change, communications and stakeholder engagement activities
  • Identifying risks and issues, ensuring timely escalation
  • Preparing reporting and governance information for senior leaders and steering groups
  • Coaching teams and stakeholders in effective project and programme management practices
  • Building and maintaining strong internal and external relationships
About You
  • Significant experience leading and delivering complex IT/technology or business change projects within a structured PM framework
  • Strong stakeholder management, consultation and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to influence, negotiate and build consensus without direct authority
  • Sound judgement, with the ability to advise senior leaders and governance groups
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Resilience, adaptability and a pragmatic, outcomes-focused approach
  • Relevant tertiary qualification and/or PM certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile) desirable
  • Public sector, commissioning, procurement or technology delivery experience an advantage
How to Apply

If either of these opportunities sounds like your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now with your CV, or contact us for a confidential discussion about which role could be the right fit.

Working across Agile Release Trains, you'll be embedded within functional delivery teams alongside business analysts, product owners, integration developers and testers.   • Defining solution architecture and artefacts (NFRs, diagrams, ADRs, patterns) that meet strategy, guardrails and privacy/security standards

  • Providing hands on design support to squads during build, test and release, resolving technical blockers quickly
  • Overseeing run time health, including release assessments, security and privacy checks, incident triage and environment management
  • Championing cloud cost transparency and optimisation in partnership with Finance
  • Growing engineering capability through mentoring, peer reviews and knowledge sharing
The appointing salary for this role is $138,301 - $178,977 based on experience. ACC offers a comprehensive benefits package which at present includes an advantageous superannuation scheme (9% contribution) with features like no mandatory employee contribution, optional life and income protection insurance.

About you | Mōu You will bring:
  • 10+ years' progressive experience in solution or technical architecture, including 3-5 years leading multi-team design decisions on large, business critical initiatives
  • A strong track record delivering end-to-end platform solutions across integration, data, security and operational readiness in complex enterprise environments
  • Hands on experience with agile/DevOps delivery (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and maintaining an architecture runway
  • Expert knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF or equivalent) and modelling standards (ArchiMate, UML)
  • A demonstrated ability to embed secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles
  • Preferred technology experience across MuleSoft, Azure cloud native integration with APM, Axway file transfer, and Oracle Integration Cloud
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across delivery teams, architects and vendors
  • High personal motivation and a genuine willingness to learn new technical domains
Relevant certifications (TOGAF, ArchiMate, a professional cloud architect credential, SAFe Architect, ITIL or CISSP) are highly regarded but not essential if you can demonstrate equivalent knowledge and experience.
You must hold New Zealand work rights at the time of application.

We know that a diverse and inclusive team helps us meet the needs of our customers, and we encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, ethnicity, national origin, gender identity, age, and those with diverse abilities.
